Never modify, create, delete, format, install, stage, commit, or write in either snapshot or the original repo. Do not load skills, call MCP/Apps, use network, read secrets, or perform external actions. You own only ./report.md. INPUTS: read /mnt/d_drive/repos/ringer/work/ob-company-hook-health-fix/evidence.md, both prior review reports, /mnt/d_drive/ringer-work/ob-company-hook-health-fix/implement-hook-health/notes.md, and compare baseline to source-work only for the owned files. Focus on staff/ob_company_agent_event.py, staff/ob_company_hook_health.py, tests/test_ob_company_agent_event.py, tests/test_ob_company_hook_health.py, supabase/functions/ob-company-ingest/index.ts, tests/test_ob_company_ingest_contract.py, and staff/README.md.
